name: anarci-antibody-numbering
description: ANARCI (Antibody Numbering And Receptor Classification) is a tool for standard antibody numbering using IMGT, Kabat, Chothia, and other schemes. It assigns positions to antibody residues and identifies CDR regions (CDR-H1/H2/H3, CDR-L1/L2/L3) for structural and functional analysis.
